versions.changelog:
- Initial release focused on continuous discovery and collection of business idea candidates from real external signal sources.
- Enumerates specific platforms and methods for sourcing ideas (e.g., SaaS marketplaces, review sites, community forums, search trends).
- Defines structured candidate organization, requiring real external signals for all ideas.
- Emphasizes strict avoidance of value judgment or feasibility assessment during the discovery phase.
- Prioritizes broad collection over premature filtering to maximize discovery potential.
